reason: Upload-only official API (https://api.autocosmos.com.mx/DocsV3): Autocosmos runs a public-docs REST API v3 (openapi.json, webhooks) since 2010; keys by request with permissions for publishing/catalog access. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
